name: firefly/observability
description: LaraFly observability: a first-party pure-PHP MeterRegistry (counter/gauge/timer) with Prometheus 0.0.4 text exposition and a Micrometer-JSON /metrics endpoint, HTTP request auto-instrumentation, the real MeterRegistry-backed CqrsMetrics recorder, a resilience circuit-breaker gauge, process metrics, a Spring/OTel-shaped Tracer port with an OpenTelemetry adapter and W3C traceparent propagation over HTTP, CQRS and EDA, trace-aware structured logging, histogram buckets. Top-of-stack, gated on a MeterRegistry bean.

suggest.open-telemetry/api: The OpenTelemetry API — required with open-telemetry/sdk for the OpenTelemetryTracer adapter (firefly.observability.tracing.enabled).
suggest.open-telemetry/sdk: The OpenTelemetry SDK (TracerProvider, samplers, console exporter) behind OpenTelemetryTracer.
suggest.open-telemetry/exporter-otlp: OTLP span export over http/protobuf or http/json (firefly.observability.tracing.exporter=otlp).
suggest.open-telemetry/transport-grpc: OTLP export over gRPC (firefly.observability.tracing.otlp.protocol=grpc; needs ext-grpc).
